comparison.objective: Pick a training lock by applying tension while setting three pins, then rotate the plug open.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual continuous tension, hook-pick insertion, sequential pin setting, and plug rotation versus hex-bit insertion, setscrew torque, and response-guided collar tuning.
comparison.success_condition: All pins set, plug at open mark, and tools withdrawn versus a locked setting yielding two compliant carriage cycles.
comparison.reason: Fine tool insertion and coordinated force are shared primitives, but lock picking tests pin binding under simultaneous bimanual control, not adjustment commissioning. No spec versions exist.
